title: Portfolio
description: Developed a responsive portfolio website featuring reusable UI components and a multi-step validated contact form.
Ensured cross-browser compatibility, automated deployment with Vercel, and achieved a 100/100 Lighthouse score for Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.

title: Car Rental
description: Developed a responsive vehicle rental application with search, filtering, and favorites functionality.
Integrated a REST API, automated deployment with GitHub Actions, and published the application on GitHub Pages.

title: Goose Track
text: Role: Frontend Team Lead, Scrum Master, Frontend Developer.
description: Developed key calendar features for a full-stack team application used to manage personal schedules and tasks.
Led a frontend team of nine developers, coordinated sprint planning and code reviews, and collaborated closely with the backend team on REST API integration.

title: Phonebook
description: Developed a full-stack contact management application with secure user authentication and complete CRUD functionality.
Built and integrated a REST API and independently deployed the backend on a DigitalOcean server.
